inclusion_reason.zh: SMCP 把身份、双向认证、安全上下文、策略执行和审计统一到 MCP 工作流，是协议级安全增强层。
inclusion_reason.en: SMCP unifies identity, mutual authentication, security context, policy enforcement, and audit across MCP as a protocol-level security layer.

abstract.zh: SMCP 在 MCP 上增加统一身份、双向认证、安全上下文传播、细粒度策略与完整审计，形成协议级纵深防护。
abstract.en: SMCP augments MCP with unified identity, mutual authentication, security-context propagation, fine-grained policy, and comprehensive audit logging for protocol-level defense.

problem.zh: 开放 MCP 连接 Agent、工具和资源后暴露越权、工具投毒、提示注入、提权和供应链风险，而现有对策多是局部补丁。
problem.en: Open MCP connections expose unauthorized access, tool poisoning, prompt injection, escalation, and supply-chain risks, while existing mitigations are fragmented patches.

approach.zh: 作者沿 MCP 工作流统一身份与会话安全语义，使认证上下文随调用传播，并在每层执行策略和审计。
approach.en: The design unifies identity and session-security semantics across the MCP workflow, propagates authenticated context through calls, and enforces policy and audit at each layer.

system_design.zh: 协议组件包括身份服务、双向认证握手、安全上下文载体、策略决策/执行点和不可抵赖审计日志，并保持 MCP 工具接口。
system_design.en: Protocol components include identity service, mutual-authentication handshake, security-context carrier, policy decision/enforcement points, and audit logs while retaining MCP tool interfaces.

key_results.zh: 论文给出 SMCP 主要组件和实际应用示例，展示如何把分散的 MCP 风险控制统一到端到端协议流程。
key_results.en: The paper specifies SMCP components and practical examples showing how fragmented MCP controls can be unified across an end-to-end protocol flow.

limitations.zh: 目前缺少跨实现互操作、性能和对抗评测，也未形式化证明上下文传播不会被降级或绕过；部署仍依赖身份与策略治理。
limitations.en: Cross-implementation interoperability, performance, adversarial tests, and formal downgrade resistance are not yet demonstrated; deployment still depends on identity and policy governance.

notes.zh: 实验矩阵与数值将在全文人工复核后补充；当前留空以避免从摘要推断。
notes.en: The experiment matrix and numbers await full-text manual review; fields remain empty to avoid inferring them from an abstract.
